# Product finding: lint aborts when a page has no `updated` field. The cel_lint
# checker evaluates the freshness rules without guarding for the key, so the
# run stops with `lint: run checker cel_lint: no such key: updated` (exit 1).

exec akb init lint-updated-kb
cd lint-updated-kb

stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write note.md

exec akb lint
stdout 'issue\(s\) found'

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Note Without Updated
summary: A note whose frontmatter has no updated field
tags: linttest
---
Content without an updated field.
